dyedresin.book.start.text: Resin clumps in all sixteen dye colours. Dye a clump in the crafting grid, place it like a plain one, and wash the colour out again whenever you like.
dyedresin.book.start.motto: "The creaking only bled orange. We had other plans."
dyedresin.book.start.step1: A resin clump and a dye in the crafting grid make a dyed clump.
dyedresin.book.start.recipe: A new guide: a book and a resin clump.
dyedresin.book.start.step2: Place it on any side of a block, like a plain clump.
dyedresin.book.start.step3: A dyed clump alone in the grid turns plain again.
dyedresin.book.clump.text: A resin clump in one of the sixteen dye colours. It places, breaks and drops just like the plain one.
dyedresin.book.clump.recipe: One clump and one dye, anywhere in the grid.
dyedresin.book.clump.recipe_eight: Eight clumps around a dye make eight at once.
dyedresin.book.clump.place: Right-click a block to stick the clump to that side. More clumps go onto the other sides of the same spot. Breaking it drops every clump on it.
dyedresin.book.clump.redye: A dyed clump takes any other dye, so you can change its colour without washing it first.
dyedresin.book.clump.wash: Put a dyed clump into the grid on its own: you get a plain resin clump back. The dye is used up.
dyedresin.book.colours.text: Every dye of the game has its clump:
